title: SQP v2.1 Dry‑Run: Dual‑Subgradient + Null‑Space (centers‑only; exact zero‑slack LP merit)
abstract: Phase‑1c SQP using LP dual subgradient as the search direction, projected into the null‑space of active constraints via SVD with trust region.
